source: published CS-80 panel charts (presets/charts/charts.json), through the cs80v2 panel curves

presets.name: Porcaro Brass (chart)
presets.reference: Steve Porcaro's CS-80 brass (Toto 'Africa', 'Human Nature'): the Brass 1 + Brass 2 preset tones. Porcaro selects BRA 1 / BRA 2 on CS-80 V4 (MusicTech, 1:47); Anthony Marinelli's hardware CS-80 'Africa' shows the same two tone-selector buttons lit (0:24). Panel values: Yamaha manual pp. 28-30.
notes: Detune and Mix read at the centre and both Feet at 8' on Porcaro's V4 panel; sub oscillator and ring modulator off
channel I: Yamaha's Brass 1 tone (owner's manual p. 29)
channel II: Yamaha's Brass 2 tone (owner's manual p. 29)

presets.name: Yamaha Brass 3 (chart)
presets.reference: Yamaha CS-80 owner's manual (1977), pp. 28-30: preset tones Brass 1 (I) and Brass 3 (II) as panel settings
notes: channel I: Yamaha's Brass 1 tone (owner's manual p. 29)
channel II: Yamaha's Brass 3 tone (owner's manual p. 29)

presets.name: Chariots Horn (chart)
presets.reference: Vangelis 'Chariots of Fire' horn, panel by Caustic on CS-80 V3 (lookmumnocomputer forum, 2021); read by eye from the screenshot
notes: Detune lever drawn just off centre (about +0.6 of 5 on V3's own scale, not hardware cents); entered as centre
sub oscillator and ring modulator levers up (off); V3 chorus and delay not copied

presets.name: Tears in Rain Swell (chart)
presets.reference: Vangelis 'Tears in Rain' (Blade Runner) swell, Reverb Machine's CS-80 V4 patch 'Tears in Rain Swell I'; read by eye from the article screenshot
notes: Mix drawn near channel I; channel II's bright, instant layer sits underneath
sub-osc vibrato light, deeper with after-touch (touch VCO pulled about 60%)
V4's Release/Portamento sliders and chorus knobs read approximately
